content:
Apple's certified refurbished product store has added several new MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models this week, along with a rare iPhone 16 Plus model, Apple Watch, and other products.

You can get Apple products at the Apple certified refurbished store for up to 15% off, which is quite a bargain.

  • Quality products at attractive prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare service can be added to your purchase
  • Engraving service and gift packaging are not available for refurbished products

Inventory at the Apple certified refurbished store changes extremely quickly, so we're publishing this report to keep everyone informed about current stock so you can get your hands on products before they're snapped up.

MacBook Pro and MacBook Air

MacBook Pro

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with 1TB storage and 24GB memory, nano-texture display: $1,999 (originally $2,349 brand new)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, with 4TB storage and 64GB memory: $4,669 (originally $5,499 brand new)
  • 14-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro, with 8TB storage and 48GB memory: $6,799 (originally $7,999 brand new)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, with 2TB storage and 24GB memory: $2,419 (originally $2,699 brand new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 512GB storage and 1TB SSD: $1,099 (originally $1,299 brand new)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 1TB SSD and 24GB memory: $1,529 (originally $1,799 brand new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (originally $1,499 brand new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, with 2TB SSD and 24GB memory: $2,119 (originally $2,499 brand new)

Apple Watch

  • Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular, 46mm gold titanium case: $639 (originally $749 brand new)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS + Cellular, 44mm midnight aluminum case: $279 (originally $329 brand new)
  • Apple Watch Series 11 GPS, 46mm silver aluminum case: $369 (originally $429 brand new)
  • Apple Watch Series 11 GPS + Cellular, 46mm jet black aluminum case: $449 (originally $529 brand new)

Apple TV 4K

Apple TV is always extremely popular at the Apple refurbished store and tends to sell out very quickly. The entry-level model sold out within days last week, and this week only the higher-end model with Ethernet has come back in stock:

  • Apple TV 4K 128GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 brand new)

iPhone 16 Plus

  • iPhone 16 Plus 128GB — White (unlocked): $699 (originally $829 brand new)
  • iPhone 16 Plus 256GB — Black (unlocked): $789 (originally $929 brand new)
  • iPhone 16 Plus 512GB — White (unlocked): $959 (originally $1,129 brand new). Apple has discontinued this model brand new, so if you want a 512GB iPhone 16 Plus, the refurbished store is your only option.
  • ……More colors and configurations available……

You can follow 9to5Tocks for the latest Apple deals throughout the week.
